backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, access control, and Stripe checkout sessions with session ownership tracking and admin-only configuration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, associated files, components, and test references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Plain-text mapping of frontend file paths to short functional descriptions for documentation or build planning.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark mode theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the PWA manifest, icons, and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.j: Digital Asset Links file with placeholder Android package name and SHA-256 certificate fingerprint.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest specifying icons, colors, shortcuts, and app metadata for installation.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with styled messaging and a reload button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing precaching, cache cleanup, and network-first fetch handling with offline fallback.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with hash-based routing for payment outcomes and conditional layout around core landing content.
frontend/src/components/DataPlansSection: Displays selectable mobile data plans by network, with purchase options including Stripe and bank transfer dialogs.
frontend/src/components/IBNFooter.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, quick links, contact details, and social media actions.
frontend/src/components/IBNHeader.tsx: Provides the site header with logo, WhatsApp contact button, and admin setup menus for Stripe and bank transfer.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Composes the full landing page including hero section, data plans, how-it-works, testimonials, FAQs, and Play Store section.
frontend/src/components/LandingPageSecti: Displays an accordion of frequently asked questions about data plans, payments, and support.
Shows a three-step explanation of choosing a plan, paying, and receiving data instantly.
Provides a multi-step guide UI explaining how to package and publish the web app to the Google Play Store, including prerequisites and asset links.
Displays a grid of customer testimonials with avatars, ratings, and quoted feedback.
frontend/src/components/payments/BankTra: Admin form for adding, editing, validating, and saving bank transfer accounts used for payments.
Shows a dialog with selectable bank accounts, copy-to-clipboard options, and optional order summary for bank transfer payments.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Displays a payment failure page with retry and WhatsApp support options.
Displays payment verification flow, showing loading, failure, or success UI based on Stripe session status.
frontend/src/components/payments/PayNowB: Handles login checks and starts a Stripe checkout session when initiating a payment, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Provides a form for admins to configure Stripe keys and allowed countries, with validation and status display.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppCTA.tsx: Renders a WhatsApp contact button that links to a prefilled WhatsApp chat, optionally showing the phone number.
frontend/src/data/mobileNetworkPlans.ts: Defines mobile network plan types and exports a list of preset data bundle offerings for various carriers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth provider and hook for managing login, stored identity, and related state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls into React Query hooks for Stripe config, checkout sessions, bank accounts, and admin checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark theme color palettes.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Provides helpers to format a WhatsApp number and generate URLs with pre-filled messages for orders and payment confirmations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and theme extensions.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, feature requirements, and build asset needs for preparing the app for Google Play Store release.
